name: Koi no Honey Trap ~Ecchi de Amai Honey Trap~
original_name: 恋のハニトー ～えっちで甘いハニートラップ～
source:
For many years, Koikawa was known as the village where love was born. There was once a festival Rentansai where lovers would promise on the riverbank to be with each other for eternity while the fireflies danced at night. However, things have long since changed.

There was a rumour that the village would be amalgamated with other towns nearby. Ryou and his friends at school loved the village dearly and planned to revive the legendary Rentansai to showcase the best of Koikawa to the world. Taking advantage of this opportunity, the girls who all greatly loved him began to boldly tempt him with their charms. Will they be able to successfully revive the festival? And will he fall into their honey trap?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/01/05/january-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
多年来，小井川被誉为爱情诞生之村。曾经有一个“恋谈祭”，恋人们在河边许诺永远在一起，而夜晚的萤火虫则在翩翩起舞。然而，事情早已发生了变化。

有传言说这个村庄将与附近的其他城镇合并。Ryou和他在学校的朋友们非常喜爱这个村庄，并计划复兴传奇的Rentansai，向世界展示小井川最好的一面。趁着这个机会，那些深爱他的女孩们开始大胆地用自己的魅力诱惑他。他们能否成功复兴这个节日？他会落入他们的美人陷阱吗？

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/01/05/january-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
